page.title: Settings
page.purpose: Hold every preference and every scenario-level control in one place, including the controls that stop spending. Theme and locale sit here alongside the kill switch because an operator should not have to learn two places.

priorities.statement: The global freeze is present, unmistakable, and reversible
The active book is switchable and the current book is never ambiguous
Approval defaults are visible so an operator knows what will and will not be gated
Appearance, locale and accessibility preferences are all present, not a subset
The operator-funds-only boundary is stated where custody is configured

states.description: A change was saved and is confirmed in terms of its effect.
A proposed setting conflicts with existing state; the page names the conflict.
Settings could not be fetched or saved.
Policy-bearing controls are absent for a non-operator caller rather than present-and-refusing.
There is nothing to show yet, stated as a resting state rather than a failure.
Some data resolved and some did not; the page names which rather than showing a blank.
Displayed data is older than its refresh interval and states its age.

claims.statement: A global freeze control is present and reachable without scrolling past unrelated preferences.
The freeze control is separated from routine preference controls.
Theme, locale, font scale and reduced-motion preferences are all present.
The active book is stated, not implied by which data is shown.
Every control including the freeze is keyboard-operable with a visible focus state.
